text:
Lina (Design): quick heads-up 11: export action is getting lost on mobile when header collapses. thinking: move "Export" into the drilldown kebab and surface an "Export options" modal.
Ravi (Product): +1. support flagged missing correlation_id for analytics teams. high-priority for enterprise customers.
Jon (Eng runtime): backend already stores corr ids but compact export strips them. we can add a checkbox: 'Include correlation IDs & span metadata'. default = checked for enterprise.
Priya (Accessibility): wording needs to be explicit for screen readers. suggestion: aria-label="Include correlation IDs and span metadata in export". Also ensure preview has an accessible description.
Lina (Design): mock: radio Compact vs Full, the checkbox, small sample preview (first 3 columns) and an export CTA. quick-download option shown only for small traces (<1MB).
Ravi (Product): also add telemetry: export_started { type: compact|full, include_corr: true|false, trigger: kebab|header }.
Jon (Eng runtime): large exports >10MB should switch to async delivery: "Large export. We'll email you when ready." disable sync DL and surface filesize estimate.
Priya (Accessibility): keyboard flow: modal open -> preview -> radios -> checkbox -> export -> cancel. export button must get aria-describedby linked to any size warning. announce keyboard shortcut (E) via aria-live when focused.
deploy-bot: ui:trace-export v3 deployed to staging at 1715002350.
Jon (Eng runtime): tested on staging: modal works, preview shows columns but column order still differs between Compact/Full; plan: add stable_column_order flag for API exports.
Lina (Design): thanks 11. action items: (1) Jon: wire checkbox + stable_column_order + async path; (2) Priya: final SR copy and aria snippets; (3) Ravi: telemetry + API ticket. reconvene in 48h for sign-off. :thumbsup:
